name: ExtensionManufacturedItemDefinition_MarketingStatus
title: R5: Allows specifying that an item is on the market for sale, or that it is not available, and the dates and locations associated (new)
purpose:
This extension is part of the cross-version definitions generated to enable use of the
element `ManufacturedItemDefinition.marketingStatus` as defined in FHIR R5
in FHIR R4.

The source element is defined as:
`ManufacturedItemDefinition.marketingStatus` 0..* `MarketingStatus`

Across FHIR versions, the element set has been mapped as:
*  R5: `ManufacturedItemDefinition.marketingStatus` 0..* `MarketingStatus`

Following are the generation technical comments:
Element `ManufacturedItemDefinition.marketingStatus` is not mapped to FHIR R4, since FHIR R5 `ManufacturedItemDefinition` is not mapped.
Element `ManufacturedItemDefinition.marketingStatus` has no mapping targets in FHIR R4. Typically, this is because the element has been added (is a new element).
